proofNotes: Direct standalone USDC -> xStock CoW quotes across the repo-owned Ethereum xStocks universe currently succeed only for NVDAx, TSLAx, SPYx.

summaries.construction: 99% stays in xStocks across 6 names. 1% remains in AUSD. Largest sleeves: MSFTx 17%, NVDAx 17%, AAPLx 16.9%.
summaries.benchmark: After estimated costs, the pinned run delivered 24.08% versus 13.16% for basket.sp500_core_v1, an excess of +10.92%.
summaries.rebalance: Rebalance only when drift clears 275 bps. Authoritative path-dependent scoring implies 3.07% annualized turnover, 11.98 bps annualized costs, and 1 rebalance over the frozen window. Legacy static proxy would have printed 99% turnover and 44.65 bps total costs with 1% parked in AUSD.
summaries.realityCheck: Authoritative scoring now uses 275 bps drift bands and implies 3.07% annualized turnover across 1 rebalance events; legacy static proxy remains available for comparison.
summaries.operator: Starter Breadth Trim + Low Cash keeps 99% in xStocks across 6 starter basket only names anchored to US Tech Leaders, with 1% in AUSD. Top sleeves: MSFTx 17%, NVDAx 17%, AAPLx 16.9%. Change from slot baseline: Breadth: 7 names -> 6 names; Cash sleeve: 4% AUSD -> 1% AUSD. After estimated costs, the pinned run delivered 24.08% versus 13.16% for basket.sp500_core_v1, an excess of +10.92%.
